control.purpose: a second Member on the SAME World: if the two Members shared one shell, "same pid" would be a global fact rather than a per-Member one. The DISCRIMINATOR is the PTY service's own owner-scoped session identity (two agents cannot share one owner-scoped session), because the in-namespace pids of two different Members can both read `2`.
